## Source: saturated model

@dobson4e [Section 5.5] defines the saturated model as the model with the maximum number of parameters that can be estimated, one per distinct covariate pattern, and says it is also called a maximal or full model.
In model selection, "full model" often means something else: the model with every candidate predictor [@dobson4e, Section 6.3].
That model is generally smaller than the saturated model.

:::
